title: Supremum norm on the Boolean domain
statement: For a function $f:\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}\to\mathbb R$, its supremum norm is $\max\{|f(\mathrm{false})|,|f(\mathrm{true})|\}$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the Boolean domain
